sn8.12:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Vaṅgīso aciraarahattappatto hutvā vimutti-sukha-{paṭisaṃvedī} tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn8.12:2.1: Kāveyyamattā vicarimha pubbe || gāmāgamam purāpuraṃ || || ath-addasāma sambuddhaṃ ||saddhā no udapajjatha || ||
sn8.12:3.1: So me dhammam adesesi || khandhe āyatānāni || dhātuyo ca || tassāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna || pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ || ||
sn8.12:4.1: Bahunnam vata atthāya || bodhim ajjhagamā muni || bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañ ca || ye niyāmagataddasā || ||
sn8.12:5.1: Svāgataṃ vata me asi || mama buddhassa santike || tisso vijjā anuppattā || kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan ti || ||
sn8.12:6.1: Pubbe-nivāsaṃ jānāmi || dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ || tevijjo iddhippattomhi || cetopariyāya-kovido ti || ||
sn8.12:7.0: Vaṅgīsa-thera-saṃyuttaṃ || || Tass-uddānaṃ || || Nikkhantam Arati c-eva || Pesalā-atimaññanā || Ānandena Subhāsitā || Sāriputta Pavāraṇā || Parosahassaṃ Kondañño || Moggalānena Gaggarā || Vaṅgīsena dvādasāti || || ********************************************
